post.caption:
Sugar triggers the same dopamine pathway as other rewards, which is why one is rarely one. Blood sugar spikes and the correction overshoots, leaving you hungrier an hour later than before you ate. Liquid sugar is the worst case: absorbed fastest, with the weakest fullness signal, so ten spoonfuls go down without registering. And low-fat products often replace the fat with sugar because the taste had to come from somewhere. Reading labels for the hidden names is the useful move.
